violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. - OBSERVED: the person in charge (PIC) is not a certified food manager (CFM).
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: PIC will need to obtain a CFM certificate within 10 calendar days.

out_items.name: Food additives; approved and properly used

violations.title: Approved Food or Color Additive
violations.observation: The following unsafe or unapproved food or color additives is applied to food: - OBSERVED: the facility is using “exberry shade purple plum-powder”, which is labeled as “sample for testing only” to make waffle cones.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from the addition of unsafe or unapproved food or color additives AND unsafe or unapproved levels of approved foods and color additives. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: immediately stop using the “exberry shade purple plum-powder” and discarding the waffle cones.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: PIC ordered a food temperature measuring device immediately.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. - OBSERVED: a chemical mixing dispenser is connected downstream from a mop sink with atmospheric vacuum breaker through an unapproved splitter.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS shared information of an approved splitter with PIC. The facility will need to install an approved splitter within 3 calendar days.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the 3-COMPARTMENT SINK with a concentration of LESS THAN 150ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE CHEMICAL MIXING DISPENSER WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER INSTALLED ON THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS SHARED THE INFORMATION OF APPROVED SPLITTER WITH CFM. CFM WILL NEED TO INSTALL AN APPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: DOK Having a CFM Present
violations.observation: No Certified Food Protection Manager Certifiction
violations.corrective_action: A certified food protection manager must be on site during all operating hours.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment.
